summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp. filed an 8-K regarding issuance and sale of $50 million aggregate principal amount of 7.00% Notes due 2029. The company entered into an underwriting agreement with Oppenheimer & Co. and a Fourth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company. Notes mature December 1, 2029, with semi-annual interest payments. They are direct unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with other unsecured debt and senior to preferred stock. No special situation event; this is a routine debt offering.
